A2_per_cell_threshold.risk_addressed: §28 champion-cell wall: global mean+1.5σ tracks high-tension cells, quiet cells trapped
A2_per_cell_threshold.implementation: _per_cell_thresholds: List[float] (one per cell). _update_adaptive_threshold computes per-cell mu+σ over each cell's own tension_history (per_cell_window=100). _check_splits reads per-cell threshold instead of global. Children inherit parent threshold on split.
A2_per_cell_threshold.back_compat: global self.split_threshold still maintained for diagnostics

B1_phi_per_cell.risk_addressed: phi_total scales super-linearly with N (4.82@N=4 → 2775@N=64); phi_best ratchets monotone from N growth alone, masking real per-cell quality drops
B1_phi_per_cell.implementation: Track phi_per_cell = phi_total / n_cells as secondary. _phi_ratchet now uses _phi_per_cell_best as comparator (not _phi_best). 80/20 cell_pool/cell_state restoration triggers when phi_per_cell drops > 20% from best.
